source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check activate shared NIC for BMC for is normal.
1. Plug network cable on shared and chcek the link status
2. Power on system and boot into BIOS setup
3. Goto "server mgmt" page to check BMC ip
4. Use BMC to login BMC Web both ipv4 and ipv6
5. To check BMC NC-SI IP can display in POST Page.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Check the ip can be present on BIOS
2. Check the Web can be login
3. DHCP or Static IP should display correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Active NIC - shared (Shared - NC-SI): verify the Shared - NC-SI NIC link is up and reachable: agent checks sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "ip link 2>&1 | grep -iE 'link|state' | head; nmcli device status 2>&1 | head 2>&1" on the host-facing side and pings the BMC IP from the network; the BIOS "server mgmt" page IP check + web login are operator/BMC-UI reads.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the host link/state + a `ping` to the BMC dedicated/shared IP so the user confirms the Shared - NC-SI NIC is active and reachable; BIOS IP + web-login are operator/UI confirmed.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: none (read-only link/address checks); plugging the cable + BIOS page are operator/KVM.

original_test_intent: Verify the shared NC-SI BMC path is active, displays the correct BMC address/source in BIOS and POST, and permits BMC WebUI login over both IPv4 and IPv6 without impairing the shared host network.
original_method: An engineer connects the approved shared port, powers into BIOS/POST, records the BMC IP and DHCP/Static presentation, and performs both IPv4 and IPv6 WebUI logins while host/BMC link health is monitored.
manual_activity: Cable insertion, BIOS/POST display inspection and authenticated BMC WebUI logins over both address families are core source checks. An engineer must perform and judge them; host link state alone is insufficient.
required_inputs: Board NC-SI controller/channel, shared connector, host interface and MAC mapping
Approved cable, peer, VLAN, IPv4/IPv6 addresses/routes and DHCP/Static expectation
POST/BIOS display criteria and BMC credentials
Host service-impact window plus independent console/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Treat the cable as both host and BMC network infrastructure; do not disturb active traffic without approval.
Do not infer NC-SI success from a generic host interface or ping.
Protect credentials and avoid connecting the shared port to an unspecified network.
Stop on host link disruption, address conflict, wrong mapping or OOB loss; preserve evidence and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Collect mapped host-interface and BMC link/configuration/health evidence before and after the manual sequence.
Correlate operator BIOS, POST and dual-stack WebUI evidence with NC-SI topology and network data.
Flag host or BMC errors and report tool results separately from the formal engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the NC-SI shared-path topology and host-impact plan.
Perform physical cabling, BIOS/POST observation and both WebUI logins.
Confirm source/address display and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient as proof. Generic host `ip link`/nmcli and ping do not identify the NC-SI controller, show BIOS/POST, authenticate WebUI sessions or validate both address families; password/host-key shortcuts are also unsuitable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use stable host NIC/MAC mapping plus vendor-supported read-only BMC/Redfish and switch telemetry as supporting evidence only, with protected credentials.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Shared cabling, BIOS and POST display, IPv4/IPv6 WebUI logins, DHCP/Static correctness and 5/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Document the NC-SI channel-to-host-port mapping, capture the operator's BIOS/POST screens and authenticated dual-stack sessions, and correlate them with read-only host/BMC/switch state plus post-test host traffic health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact NC-SI controller, shared NIC and network peer.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC/NIC firmware, driver, browser and switch configuration.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform NC-SI topology, BIOS/BMC guide and project network plan.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable topology and host-impact evidence without replacing visible UI checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; host link-up or ping cannot substitute for source/display/login criteria.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: NC-SI mapping, dual-stack/source expectations and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The host and BMC can have different protocol state on the same physical link.

project_override_considerations: The project selects DHCP or Static expectation, dual-stack endpoints and host-impact window. Missing parameters mean not ready, not permanently blocked. Removing POST, BIOS or WebUI evidence is a disclosed coverage override, not equivalent completion.
expected_evidence: NC-SI topology and shared connector/host/BMC mapping
Timestamped physical link plus BIOS and POST address/source displays
Authenticated BMC WebUI evidence over approved IPv4 and IPv6 paths
Host and BMC post-test reachability/error logs and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source coherently tests the active shared NC-SI path across physical link, firmware display and dual-stack BMC access.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The workflow is clear. Platform topology and project network data are execution-readiness requirements, not permanent blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject PARTIAL under the locked manual UI rule and reject its low-risk framing; retain host telemetry only as support.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its NC-SI topology and shared-host risk analysis while reclassifying the UI core as MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes POST display and both WebUI sessions explicit, with agent telemetry separated from acceptance.

review_improvement: Prevents a healthy host link from being misreported as a healthy NC-SI BMC path and requires evidence that shared operation did not harm host networking.
independent_technical_reasoning: NC-SI telemetry can be collected automatically, but the source's acceptance includes BIOS, POST and BMC WebUI visual/interative checks. Those human core steps govern classification, so this case is MANUAL ONLY despite useful agent support.
